purpose.domain_detail: Test runner for GCSort (a COBOL-based sort utility), exercising OUTFIL INCLUDE/OMIT/SPLIT/SAVE/STARTREC/ENDREC/OUTREC features
purpose.summary: This program is a test harness for the GCSort sort utility. It iterates over a set of predefined test cases (soutfsqf01-05), writes take-files with sort control statements, executes GCSort via CALL or system commands, and collects/reports return codes in an epilog section. It calls 'gctestgetop' to detect the runtime environment and version.

notable_features: REDEFINES used for array simulation over inline-initialized data
Large embedded data arrays with sort control statement strings
25 CALLs and 98 PERFORMs indicating structured test orchestration
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
organization is line sequential file access
verdict.notes: Source is truncated to first 16000 chars; the procedure division is only partially visible but the structure is clear. The program is a well-structured test suite, not a toy. Author is Sauro Menna, dated 2017-01-03, licensed LGPL 3.0.
